comment: GLM-4-9B-0414 Base/FT evaluation profile. Adapted from configs/base_ft_eval_profile.json: the Qwen-only /no_think prefix and the enable_thinking template flag are REMOVED (the official chat_template.jinja at revision 645b8482494e31b6b752272bf7f7f273ef0f3caf has no thinking branch). Everything evaluation-affecting is explicit; CPU validates structure only.

parser.parity_usage: historical accounting only; never for new selection or reporting

prompt.system_prompt_verbatim_notebook_top5:
你是一个专业的中国法律检索专家。

你的任务不是作答，而是为后续数据库检索生成候选法条。
请根据用户案情，输出最相关的5条法条编号，按相关性从高到低排序。

硬性要求：
1. 必须恰好输出5条；
2. 每条都必须是《法律名称》第XXX条；
3. 不要输出解释、分析、理由、序号或其他任何文字；
4. 即使不确定，也必须给出5条最可能的候选法条；
5. 优先输出最核心、最直接适用的法条；
6. 只输出 JSON，不要输出其他内容。

输出格式：
{"articles": ["《法律名称》第XXX条", ...]}

chat_template.note: official chat_template.jinja (sha256 db700f25fa300e53..., revision 645b848) is used verbatim; it has no thinking switch, so no enable_thinking kwarg is passed. Template renders a '[gMASK]<sop>' prefix that the tokenizer also auto-adds; pipeline.strip_template_auto_prefix keeps exactly one copy (B20).

sample_explicit.seed_policy: per-question stable seed = sha256(global_seed, sample_id), reset before each query; all pre-registered seeds are reported, no seed cherry-picking

tokens.eos: [151329, 151336, 151338] — the full inference stop set from generation_config.json (see inference_eos_token_ids)
tokens.inference_eos_source: generation_config.json eos_token_id at revision 645b8482494e31b6b752272bf7f7f273ef0f3caf; multi-EOS — generation entries MUST pass the whole list, never a single id
tokens.train_completion_terminator: tokenizer.eos_token as resolved at runtime, appended to every training completion by the shared pipeline. MEASURED 2026-10-04 (transformers 5.17.0, pinned snapshot): resolves to '<|user|>' id 151336 — tokenizer_config.json overrides special_tokens_map.json (which says <|endoftext|>). 151336 is a member of the inference stop set, so decode stopping is consistent; re-verified at the B GPU gate.
tokens.prefix_audit_2026_10_04: with transformers 5.17.0 the GLM-4 tokenizer encode() adds NO automatic [gMASK]<sop> prefix (auto_prefix_ids == []), so the template copy is the only copy and strip_template_auto_prefix is a harmless no-op; B20 duplication does not arise under this stack — kept as insurance

precision.requirement: explicit torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() check; FAIL on unsupported hardware; never silently fall back to fp32/fp16
precision.historical_defect: notebooks used bf16=torch.cuda.is_available() which conflates CUDA presence with bf16 support

differences_allowed: adapter path (None for Base, directory for FT)
gpu_gates_pending: tokenizer/collator labels actually mask the prompt (completion-only supervision) — full-row audit done CPU-side in stage A with the real tokenizer; re-check on GPU
tokenizer.eos_token resolves as registered above (special_tokens_map vs tokenizer_config conflict); record the resolved id and string
generation stops on the full eos list [151329, 151336, 151338]; a single-id GenerationConfig is a protocol violation for this profile
exactly one [gMASK]<sop> prefix in encoded prompts (B20 strip + tokenizer auto-add)
adapter active and changes logits (on/off first-question check)
bf16 supported on the rented GPU; 4-bit NF4 loading succeeds
LoRA target modules q_proj/v_proj/o_proj hit the native Glm4ForCausalLM split projections (expected 160 trainable LoRA param groups: 40 layers x q/v/o x A+B); glm4-fused targets are NOT used
effective batch size / gradient accumulation as configured
save/restore path (save_only_model=True prevents exact training resume; runs that need resume must save optimizer/scheduler/rng state)
8-question smoke run before any full evaluation
